descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]在[From.GetName]上获得了惊人的发现——[From.GetPlanetMoon]充满了外星生命！这是历史上第一次，我们遇到和[Root.Owner.GetHomeWorldName]完全不一样的生命形态。

这一惊人发现使得相信“我们在宇宙中孤苦伶仃”的人闭上了嘴。尽管这些[From.GetName]上的外星生命似乎并无高等智慧，但很可能用不了多久我们就会遇到。
descriptions.en:
The [Root.GetName] has made a startling find on [From.GetName] - the [From.GetPlanetMoon] is teeming with alien life! For the first time in history, we have encountered life forms that did not originate on [Root.Owner.GetHomeWorldName].

This amazing discovery has silenced those who believed we were alone in the universe. Although none of the alien creatures found on [From.GetName] are sapient, it is likely only a matter of time before we encounter beings that are.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]在[from.GetName]上获得了惊人的发现——[from.GetPlanetMoon]充满了外星生命！这是我们第一次遇到和自己完全不一样的生命形态。

这一发现终于使我们相信，[root.owner.capital_scope.GetName]这颗行星，在宇宙中并不孤独。尽管这些[from.GetName]上的外星生命似乎并无高等智慧，但很可能用不了多久我们就会遇到……
descriptions.en:
The [Root.GetName] has made a startling find on [from.GetName]: the [from.GetPlanetMoon] is teeming with alien life! For the first time, we have encountered lifeforms which originated outside our self.

This discovery finally confirms that we, the planet [root.owner.capital_scope.GetName], are not alone in the universe. Although none of the alien creatures found on [from.GetName] are sapient, it is likely only a matter of time before we encounter beings that are...

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]在[From.GetName]上有了意外发现——[From.GetPlanetMoon]上充满了外星生命。这是我们有史以来第一次遭遇源自[Root.Owner.GetHomeWorldName]以外的有机生命。

尽管[From.GetName]上发现的外星生物都没有智慧，最新校正过的预测显示星系中存在智慧有机体的可能性非常高。
descriptions.en:
The [Root.GetName] has made an unanticipated discovery on [From.GetName] - the [From.GetPlanetMoon] is teeming with alien lifeforms. For the first time in history, we have encountered organic life that did not originate on [Root.Owner.GetHomeWorldName].

Although none of the alien creatures found on [From.GetName] are sapient, newly recalibrated prognoses suggest a high probability of intelligent organics in the galaxy.

descriptions.zh: 我们一直都在为这一天作准备。[Root.GetName]确认了外星有机体存在于[From.GetName]之上。尽管遭遇的生命体都没有较高的认知能力，我们无法排除星系中极有可能充满了智慧有机体的可能性。
descriptions.en: We have been preparing for this day. The [Root.GetName] has confirmed the existence of alien organics on [From.GetName]. Though none of the encountered lifeforms possess higher reasoning functions, we cannot preclude the now heightened probability of a galaxy infested with sapient organics.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { owner = { has_civic = civic_machine_terminator } }

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]在[From.GetName]有了史无前例的发现——[From.GetPlanetMoon]上充满了外星有机体！尽管这些生命体似乎都没有自我意识来感激[Root.Owner.GetAdj]照料，但遭遇到更高级智慧也只是时间问题！
descriptions.en: A historic discovery has been made by the [Root.GetName] on [From.GetName] - the [From.GetPlanetMoon] is teeming with alien organics! Though none of the new lifeforms appear to possess the self-awareness required to appreciate [Root.Owner.GetAdj] pampering, it is likely only a matter of time before we encounter beings that do!
descriptions.condition: trigger = { owner = { has_civic = civic_machine_servitor } }

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]报告在[From.GetName]上有了重大发现：发现了大量外星有机生命！尽管它们的进化程度都不足以成为合适的同化对象，在[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]之外遭遇智慧有机体的可能性现在已大大增加。
descriptions.en: The [Root.GetName] reports a momentous find on [From.GetName]: myriad alien organic lifeforms have been discovered! While none of them has evolved to a stage we would consider desirable for assimilation, the likelihood of encountering sapient organics beyond [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] is now more promising than ever.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { owner = { has_civic = civic_machine_assimilator } }

descriptions.zh:
一位[Root.Owner.GetScientist]说，“快来看看这个小家伙！”

有外星生命，就在[From.GetName]！这些野东西可能不会那么快能和我们说话，但至少我们知道在宇宙的航行中不是孤单的了！

可能我们最后会发现这个星系到处都是各种不同的生命。
descriptions.en:
In the words of one [Root.Owner.GetScientist], "Get a load of this little guy!"

Alien life, right here on [From.GetName]! These wild things will not be talking to us any time soon, but at least we know we are not alone on the cosmic journey.

The galaxy just may turn out to be rife with lifeforms after all.

descriptions.zh:
我们兴奋得发抖。

有外星生命，就在[From.GetName]！这些野东西可能不会那么快能和我们说话，但至少我们知道在宇宙的航行中不是孤单的了！

可能我们最后会发现这个星系到处都是各种不同的生命。
descriptions.en:
We vibrate with excitement.

Alien life, right here on [From.GetName]! These wild things will not be talking to us any time soon, but at least we know we are not alone on the cosmic journey.

The galaxy just may turn out to be rife with lifeforms after all.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]在[From.GetName]上获得了惊人的发现——[From.GetPlanetMoon]充满了外星有机生命！这是历史上第一次，我们遇到了起源于[Root.Owner.GetHomeWorldName]以外的生命形态。

这一惊人发现使得相信“我们在宇宙中孤苦伶仃”的人闭上了嘴。尽管这些[From.GetName]上的外星生命似乎并无高等智慧，但很可能用不了多久我们就会遇到智慧物种，不管是有机体还是机械体。
descriptions.en:
The [Root.GetName] has made a startling find on [From.GetName] - the [From.GetPlanetMoon] is teeming with organic alien creatures. For the first time in history, we have encountered life forms that did not originate on [Root.Owner.GetHomeWorldName].

This amazing discovery has silenced those who believed we were alone in the universe. Although none of the alien creatures found on [From.GetName] are sapient, it is likely only a matter of time before we encounter sentient beings, biological or mechanical.

descriptions.zh: 生命。耀眼地演化的生命触手可及，我们随时可以从中采集样本促进自身的发展。自古以来我们就收集了[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]上所有的有趣样本，但却从来不敢设想在刚踏出征程的第一步就可以寻得更多的独特基因。
descriptions.en: Life. Glorious evolved life is out there and ready to be sampled for our progress. We have long since gathered all interesting samples on [Owner.GetHomeWorldName] and didn't dare hope that we would have access to further genetic uniqueness so soon after leaving home.

label.en: We may not be alone out here.

label.zh: 我们会准备好面对他们。
label.en: We will be ready for them.

label.zh: 完美。准备初步的互娱协议。

descriptions.zh: 我们的降临对[planet.GetName]无异于一场大灾变。一股巨大的冲击波冲刷了这片没有生命的大陆，由于数百万吨的碎片被抛入大气层，[planet.GetName]的宜居性显著的下降了。我们的殖民者—被安全地包围在陨石的岩石核心—将很快从庇护处走出，并开始安装预制殖民地基础设施。
descriptions.en: Our arrival on [planet.GetName] is nothing short of cataclysmic. A massive shockwave scours a continent clean of life, and the habitability level of [planet.GetName] drops noticeably as megatons of debris are thrown into the atmosphere. Our colonists - encased safely within the rocky core of the meteorite - will soon emerge and begin setting up prefabricated colonial infrastructure.

descriptions.zh:
在§Y[Root.GetName]§!的一片大陆上，我们的殖民船徐徐降落在一座巨大河口三角洲。这片气候温和的林地将会提供庇护所和唾手可得的原材料。

舰船已经被改造成了§Y舰船改装庇护所§!，作为指挥中心，它的反应堆心被取下来作为殖民地的临时能量来源。无数装满建材的帐篷以及简陋的棚屋如雨后春笋般出现在船体周围，无数殖民者陆陆续续下船登陆，标志着[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]在外星球上第一座城市的诞生。
descriptions.en:
Our colony ship has gently touched down at the mouth of a large river delta on one of the continents on §Y[Root.GetName]§!. This temperate, forested area will provide shelter and easy access to raw materials.

The ship has been converted into a §YReassembled Ship Shelter§! to serve as headquarters, and its reactor core removed to act as the colony's temporary power source. Tents filled with construction materials, alongside prefab shelters, have sprung up around the ship's hull as colonists disembark, marking the first [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] city on an alien world.

descriptions.zh:
在§Y[Root.GetName]§!绵延整个[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的海洋上，我们的殖民船徐徐落在一片大型群岛的海岸附近，溅起了雪白的浪花。这片丰饶的岛链可以为食物产出提供绝佳的环境。

舰船已经被改造成了§Y舰船改装庇护所§!，作为指挥中心，它的反应堆心被取下来作为殖民地的临时能量来源。无数装满建材的帐篷以及简陋的棚屋如雨后春笋般出现在船体周围，无数殖民者陆陆续续下船登陆，标志着[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]在外星球上第一座城市的诞生。
descriptions.en:
Our colony ship has made a gentle splashdown in the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]-spanning ocean of §Y[Root.GetName]§!, near the shores of a large archipelago. This fertile island chain provide a suitable environment for growing food.

The ship has been converted into a §YReassembled Ship Shelter§! to serve as headquarters, and its reactor core removed to act as the colony's temporary power source. Tents filled with construction materials, alongside prefab shelters, have sprung up around the ship's hull as colonists disembark, marking the first [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] city on an alien world.

descriptions.zh:
我们的殖民船徐徐降落在§Y[Root.GetName]§!上一片巨大绿洲的边缘，稳稳地停靠在可以遮挡沙漠狂风又便于取水的山脚下。

舰船已经被改造成了§Y舰船改装庇护所§!，作为指挥中心，它的反应堆心被取下来作为殖民地的临时能量来源。无数装满建材的帐篷以及简陋的棚屋如雨后春笋般出现在船体周围，无数殖民者陆陆续续下船登陆，标志着[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]在外星球上第一座城市的诞生。
descriptions.en:
Our colony ship has gently touched down by the outskirts of a large oasis on §Y[Root.GetName]§!, at the foot of a mountain, offering shelter from the desert winds and easy access to water.

The ship has been converted into a §YReassembled Ship Shelter§! to serve as headquarters, and its reactor core removed to act as the colony's temporary power source. Tents filled with construction materials, alongside prefab shelters, have sprung up around the ship's hull as colonists disembark, marking the first [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] city on an alien world.

descriptions.zh:
我们的殖民船在§Y[Root.GetName]§!的密林中找到了一片林间空地完成了行星着陆。哨卫子个体已经部署到周围防止潜在猎食者的袭扰。

舰船已经被改造成了§Y舰船改装庇护所§!，作为指挥中心，它的反应堆心被取下来作为殖民地的临时能量来源。无数装满建材的帐篷以及简陋的棚屋如雨后春笋般出现在船体周围，无数殖民者陆陆续续下船登陆，标志着[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]在外星球上第一座城市的诞生。
descriptions.en:
Our colony ship has found a clearing in the dense jungles of §Y[Root.GetName]§! and made planetfall. Sentry drones have been deployed to guard against potential predators.

The ship has been converted into a §YReassembled Ship Shelter§! to serve as headquarters, and its reactor core removed to act as the colony's temporary power source. Tents filled with construction materials, alongside prefab shelters, have sprung up around the ship's hull as colonists disembark, marking the first [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] city on an alien world.

descriptions.zh:
我们的殖民船徐徐降落在了§Y[Root.GetName]§!赤道附近的一片平坦开阔的平顶山上。峡谷中的河流非常便于获取净水。

舰船已经被改造成了§Y舰船改装庇护所§!，作为指挥中心，它的反应堆心被取下来作为殖民地的临时能量来源。无数装满建材的帐篷以及简陋的棚屋如雨后春笋般出现在船体周围，无数殖民者陆陆续续下船登陆，标志着[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]在外星球上第一座城市的诞生。
descriptions.en:
Our colony ship has gently touched down at the top of a large, flat mesa near the equator of §Y[Root.GetName]§!. The rivers that flow in the canyons below provide easy access to fresh water.

The ship has been converted into a §YReassembled Ship Shelter§! to serve as headquarters, and its reactor core removed to act as the colony's temporary power source. Tents filled with construction materials, alongside prefab shelters, have sprung up around the ship's hull as colonists disembark, marking the first [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] city on an alien world.

descriptions.zh:
我们的殖民船徐徐降落在了§Y[Root.GetName]§!上一片宽阔而空旷的草原，紧挨着一片巨大山脊以抵挡寒风。

舰船已经被改造成了§Y舰船改装庇护所§!，作为指挥中心，它的反应堆心被取下来作为殖民地的临时能量来源。无数装满建材的帐篷以及简陋的棚屋如雨后春笋般出现在船体周围，无数殖民者陆陆续续下船登陆，标志着[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]在外星球上第一座城市的诞生。
descriptions.en:
Our colony ship has gently touched down on the wide, empty steppe of §Y[Root.GetName]§!, nestled behind a large ridge, sheltering it from the cold winds.

The ship has been converted into a §YReassembled Ship Shelter§! to serve as headquarters, and its reactor core removed to act as the colony's temporary power source. Tents filled with construction materials, alongside prefab shelters, have sprung up around the ship's hull as colonists disembark, marking the first [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] city on an alien world.

descriptions.zh:
我们的殖民船徐徐降落在了§Y[Root.GetName]§!上一个白雪皑皑的山谷中。周围的山脉带来了充足的保护，并且提供了可靠的水资源。

舰船已经被改造成了§Y舰船改装庇护所§!，作为指挥中心，它的反应堆心被取下来作为殖民地的临时能量来源。无数装满建材的帐篷以及简陋的棚屋如雨后春笋般出现在船体周围，无数殖民者陆陆续续下船登陆，标志着[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]在外星球上第一座城市的诞生。
descriptions.en:
Our colony ship has gently touched down in a snow-covered valley on §Y[Root.GetName]§!. The surrounding mountain chains offer sufficient protection from the elements and provide an reliable water supply.

The ship has been converted into a §YReassembled Ship Shelter§! to serve as headquarters, and its reactor core removed to act as the colony's temporary power source. Tents filled with construction materials, alongside prefab shelters, have sprung up around the ship's hull as colonists disembark, marking the first [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] city on an alien world.

descriptions.zh:
我们的殖民船缓慢的降落在覆盖着§Y[Root.GetName]§!广阔的草原上。这里的大气略微干燥但同样怡人，在确定着陆点的过程中也观察到一大群温顺的食草动物。

舰船已被改造成新居住地的行政基地，它的反应堆核心正在被拆除来用作殖民地的暂时能量来源。

数百个小帐篷和简易房环绕着星舰巨大的船体，殖民者开始大片大片地登陆——在这外星世界上的第一座[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]之城。
descriptions.en:
Our colony ship has gently touched down on the sprawling savanna that covers most of §Y[Root.GetName]§!. The shimmering air is dry yet pleasant, and a large herd of docile herbivores can be seen observing from a distance as our first landing site is established.

The ship has been permanently converted into the administrative headquarters of the new settlement, and its reactor core is in the process of being removed so that it may serve as the colony's temporary power source.

Hundreds of small tents and prefab shelters have sprung up around the former starship's massive hull as colonists begin to disembark in large numbers - the first [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] city on an alien world.

descriptions.zh:
我们的舰船想方设法，以惊人且优雅的姿态在§Y[Root.GetName]§!上无数锯齿状的山峰中回旋，并成功降落在一个遮蔽山谷中的理想着陆点。

舰船已被改造成新居住地的行政基地，它的反应堆核心正在被拆除来用作殖民地的暂时能量来源。

数百个小帐篷和简易房环绕着星舰巨大的船体，殖民者开始大片大片地登陆——在这外星世界上的第一座[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]之城。
descriptions.en:
Our colony ship managed, with surprising grace, to maneuver between the massive peaks that are so prevalent in the jagged landscape of §Y[Root.GetName]§!. It touched down in a sheltered valley that will serve as an ideal first landing site.

The ship has been permanently converted into the administrative headquarters of the new settlement, and its reactor core is in the process of being removed so that it may serve as the colony's temporary power source.

Hundreds of small tents and prefab shelters have sprung up around the former starship's massive hull as colonists begin to disembark in large numbers - the first [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] city on an alien world.

descriptions.zh:
我们的殖民船成功地在§Y[Root.GetName]§!进行了行星着陆。数以千计的工作单元从货仓中涌出，开始建造一座初步的§Y部署前哨§!以用作殖民地扩张。地表资源矿藏的编目仍在继续，着陆点附近的侵略性野生动物已经完成了无害化处理。

资源充足后，我们现在已经准备好在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上大规模生产更多的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]单元。我们的第一个殖民地大获成功。
descriptions.en:
Our colony ship has successfully made planetfall on §Y[Root.GetName]§!. Thousands of work units have emerged from the cargo bays to build an initial §YDeployment Post§! for settlement expansion. Efforts to catalog surface resource deposits continue, and aggressive wildlife near the landing site has been pacified.

We are now ready to mass-produce additional [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] units on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon] as resources allow. Our first colony is a success.

descriptions.zh:
“惊奇!”[ruler.GetRegnalName]喊道。“这是个新世界，充满了新机遇！”

我们刚一把殖民船改造成大本营，第一批探险者就已经准备好面对这个星球可能给他们带来的一切挑战了。
descriptions.en:
"Incredible," [ruler.GetRegnalName] exclaimed. "A new world ripe with opportunity!"

As we convert our colony ship into a base camp, the first explorers are already gearing up to experience whatever this world has to offer.

descriptions.zh:
令人颤栗的发现！一颗遍布机遇的新星球！！

我们刚一把殖民船改造成大本营，探险节点就已经准备好面对这个星球可能给我们带来的一切挑战了。
descriptions.en:
A thrilling discovery! A new world ripe with opportunity!!

As we convert our colony ship into a base camp, exploratory nodes are already gearing up to experience whatever this world has to offer.

descriptions.zh:
我们的殖民船降落在§Y[Root.GetName]§!的地表。选择的着陆场气候温和且易于获取资源矿藏。

殖民船被改造成了一座§Y舰船改装庇护所§!用作指挥中心，它的反应堆心被取下来作为殖民地的临时能量来源。无数装满建材的帐篷以及简陋的棚屋如雨后春笋般出现在船体周围，无数智能人陆陆续续下船登陆，标志着[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]在外星球上第一座城市的诞生。
descriptions.en:
Our colony ship has touched down on the surface of §Y[Root.GetName]§!. The landing site was chosen for its calm weather and accessible resource deposits.

The ship has been converted into a §YReassembled Ship Shelter§! to serve as headquarters, and its reactor core removed to act as the colony's temporary power source. Hundreds of prefab shelters have sprung up around the ship's hull as our droids disembark, marking the first [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] city on an alien world.

descriptions.zh:
我们的殖民船降落在§Y[Root.GetName]§!的地表。选择的着陆场气候温和且易于获取资源矿藏。

殖民船被改造成了一座§Y舰船改装庇护所§!用作指挥中心，我们扩散到了船体周围，用任何能找到的材料搭建起了遮蔽物。这标志着在外星球上第一个分巢的诞生。
descriptions.en:
Our colony ship has touched down on the surface of §Y[Root.GetName]§!. The landing site was chosen for its calm weather and accessible resource deposits.

The ship has been converted into a §YReassembled Ship Shelter§!, and around its husk, we have spread, weaving shelters from whatever materials were available. This marks the birth of a new hive on an alien world.

label.zh: 科学的进展会推动我们的殖民地更进一步。
label.en: Scientific progress will drive our colony forward.

label.zh: 我们的殖民地是崇高旨意的见证。
label.en: Our colony is a testament to our higher purpose.

label.zh: 力量和警觉才能守护我们的未来。
label.en: Strength and vigilance will secure our future.

label.zh: 我们的殖民地会在和平、和谐中繁荣昌盛。
label.en: Our colony will thrive in peace and harmony.

label.zh: 纪律与秩序将会引导我们的殖民地。
label.en: Order and hierarchy will guide our colony.

label.zh: 拥抱多样性可以让我们的殖民地更加强大。
label.en: Embracing diversity will strengthen our colony.

label.zh: 我们殖民地将拥有纯洁与安全。
label.en: Our colony will remain pure and protected.

label.zh: 如同我们的母星一般，平等将会塑造好这个殖民地。
label.en: As on our homeworld, equality will shape this colony.

label.zh: 殖民地会与蜂巢一体化发展。
label.en: The colony grows as one with the Hive.

label.zh: 殖民地将会以最高效率执行功能。
label.en: The colony will function with perfect efficiency.
A whole new banquet to sample.

descriptions.zh:
我们与智慧外星生命初次相遇的新闻使人们产生了复杂的情绪。这一发现确认了我们长久以来的怀疑——我们在星辰之间并不孤单。新的外星物种既是机会，也是威胁。我们必须保持警惕。

这些外星人的科技水平与我们类似，表明他们可能和我们大概在同一时期实现了太空旅行。
descriptions.en:
The news that we have encountered intelligent alien life for the first time has been received with mixed feelings by our populace. This confirms what we had long suspected - we are not alone in this galaxy. Each new alien species we encounter represents both an opportunity and a threat. We must be wary.

These particular xenos have a level of technology similar to our own, indicating that we achieved space flight at roughly the same time.

descriptions.zh:
我们与智慧外星生命的初次相遇的新闻在[Root.GetName]如野火般扩散开来。人们为此十分着迷，媒体充满了对其文化与组织形式的报导和推测。“我们在宇宙中并不孤单”这一真相引起了[Root.Capital.GetName]人民的欢呼。

和我们一样，这些外星人似乎也才刚刚登上星系的舞台，他们的科技水平与我们类似。
descriptions.en:
The news that we have encountered intelligent alien life for the first time is spreading like wildfire throughout the [Root.GetName]. Our citizens are fascinated by these beings, and the media is full of reports and speculation on their culture and society. The revelation that we are not alone in this galaxy has largely been greeted with celebration on [Root.Capital.GetName].

Just like us, the aliens appear to be relative newcomers on the galactic stage and their level of technology is similar to our own.

descriptions.zh:
我们与智慧外星生命初次相遇的新闻在整个帝国产生了动乱。这些奇怪生物的录像泄露到了[Root.GetName]的媒体并迅速传播开来，许多人陷入了巨大的恐慌。[Root.Capital.GetName]数个城市发生了不安定事件。

这些奇怪外星人的科技水平似乎与我们类似，他们明显能够进行太空旅行。他们对我们这一伟大种群的态度是恐惧、仇恨还是冷漠，则无人知晓。
descriptions.en:
The news that we have encountered intelligent alien life for the first time has shaken our society to the core. Leaked footage of these bizarre creatures is spreading through media outlets across the [Root.GetName], and many citizens have been gripped by panic. Rioting has been reported in several cities on [Root.Capital.GetName].

The strange xenos appear to have achieved a level of technology similar to our own, and they are clearly spacefaring. Whether they regard our great species with fear, hatred or cold indifference is anyone's guess.

descriptions.zh:
我们的理论模型早就指出星系中有其他智慧文明存在。现在这一理论已被证实。

我们遭遇的这个外星种群拥有和我们相近的科技水平，说明他们实现太空航行的时间与我们大致相同。
descriptions.en:
Our theoretical models have long suggested the existence of other intelligent civilizations in our galaxy. This theory has now been confirmed.

The alien political entity that we have encountered has a level of technology similar to our own, indicating that we achieved space flight at roughly the same time.

descriptions.zh:
寂静的太空对我们的呼唤做出了回应！这个与我们科技水平相当的外星文明，他们一定和我们在差不多的时候踏上了星海的征途。

他们的出现引领着一个全新的体验前言。他们会成为志趣相投的盟友，或是磨炼勇气的试金石？无论如何，未知的刺激正在召唤着我们前进。
descriptions.en:
Out of the silence of space, our calls have been answered! An alien civilization with equivalent technology. They must have entered the galactic fray right around the time we did.

Their appearance heralds a new frontier of experience. Do they come as like minded allies, or rivals to test our mettle? Either way, the thrill of the unknown beckons us forward.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { has_origin = origin_storm_chasers }

label.zh: 我们应该做好最坏的打算。

options.script:
name = progress.4.h.storm
trigger = { has_origin = origin_storm_chasers }

descriptions.zh:
我们与有智慧但未充分发展的外星文明正式接触的新闻使人们产生了复杂的情绪。这也明确了一件我们长久相信的事情，我们的星系中存在有从未考虑过探索他们行星以外世界的非太空文明外星人。

新的外形物种既是机会，也是威胁。我们必须谨慎。这些外星人的科技水平与我们相比十分原始，他们还没有实现太空旅行。我们必须决定如何与他们交流。
descriptions.en:
The news that we have made formal contact with an intelligent yet undeveloped civilization has been received with mixed feelings by our populace. This confirms our long-held belief that there are non-space-faring aliens within our galaxy who may have never even considered exploring beyond their own planet.

Each species we encounter represents both an opportunity and a threat. We must be wary. The technological level of these particular aliens is low by our standards. They have not yet achieved space flight. We must decide how best to engage them going forward.

descriptions.zh:
我们与有智慧但未充分发展的外星文明正式接触的新闻在[Root.GetName]如野火般扩散开来。人们为此十分着迷，媒体充满了对其文化和组织形式的报告和推测。“我们的星系中存在有从未考虑过探索他们行星以外世界的非太空文明外星人”这一真相引起了[Root.Capital.GetName]人民的欢呼。

我们的科技水平遥遥领先，他们还没有实现空间旅行。虽然在我们看来他们十分原始，但也许也有可以学习的地方。
descriptions.en:
The news that we have made formal contact with an intelligent yet undeveloped civilization is spreading like wildfire throughout the [Root.GetName]. Our citizens are fascinated by these beings, and the media is full of reports and speculation on their culture and society. The confirmation that there are non-space-faring aliens within our galaxy who may have never even considered exploring beyond their own planet has largely been greeted with celebration on [Root.Capital.GetName].

Our level of technology is far ahead of theirs. They have not yet developed space flight. Despite this, we could probably still learn much by studying them.

descriptions.zh:
我们与有智慧但未充分发展的外星文明正式接触的新闻在深刻地动摇了整个社会。这些奇怪生物的录像泄露到了[Root.GetName]的媒体并迅速传播开来，许多人陷入了巨大的恐慌。[Root.Capital.GetName]数个城市发生了不安定事件。

原始落后的外星人在科技水平方面远远落后于我们，且尚未发展出太空旅行，祈祷永远没有那一天吧。
descriptions.en:
The news that we have made formal contact with an intelligent yet undeveloped civilization has shaken our society to the core. Leaked footage of these bizarre creatures is spreading through media outlets across the [Root.GetName], and many citizens have been gripped by panic. Rioting has been reported in several cities on [Root.Capital.GetName].

These aliens are far below our own level of technology. They have not yet developed space flight. For all our sakes, let us pray they never will.

descriptions.zh:
我们的理论模型早就指出星系中有其他智慧文明存在。现在这一理论已被证实。

我们遭遇的这个外星政治实体还没有实现太空航行。我们必须决定如何妥善对待这些[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]物种。
descriptions.en:
Our theoretical models have long suggested the existence of other intelligent civilizations in our galaxy. This theory has now been confirmed.

The alien political entity that we have encountered has not yet invented space flight. We must determine how best to deal with these [GetPreFTLLowerPlural].

descriptions.zh:
我们在[From.Planet.GetName]发现了未开智生命形式。我们的一位[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]表示，“这些东西虽然看起来平平无奇，但蕴含着巨大的潜力！”

当然现在为止他们还是未开智的。观察这些物种繁荣昌盛是一件再有趣不过的事情了。
descriptions.en:
We have discovered pre-sapient lifeforms on [From.Planet.GetName]. As one of our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] put it, "These things might not seem like much yet, but their potential is massive!"

For now however, they remain pre-sapient. It should be more than interesting to observe these creatures thrive.

descriptions.zh:
我们在[From.Planet.GetName]发现了未开智生命形式。

我们兴奋与观察它们的潜力究竟到何等地步，但就目前为止它们仍然尚未开智。观察这些物种繁荣昌盛是一件再有趣不过的事情了。
descriptions.en:
We have discovered pre-sapient lifeforms on [From.Planet.GetName].

We thrill to see what comes of their potential, but for now, they remain pre-sapient. It should be more than interesting to observe these creatures thrive.

descriptions.zh:
我们与智慧外星生命初次相遇的新闻使人们产生了复杂的情绪。这一发现确认了我们长久以来的怀疑——我们在星系并不孤单。新的外星物种既是机会，也是威胁。我们必须保持警惕。

这些外星人似乎在星系舞台上十分活跃——貌似已有千年之久，科技水平远在我们之上。我们必须十分小心。
descriptions.en:
The news that we have encountered intelligent alien life for the first time has been received with mixed feelings by our populace. This confirms what we had long suspected - we are not alone in this galaxy. Each new alien species we encounter represents both an opportunity and a threat. We must be wary.

These particular xenos appear to have been active on the galactic stage for some time - their empire is likely thousands of years old, and their technology is far ahead of our own. We should be careful when dealing with them.

descriptions.zh:
我们与智慧外星生命的初次相遇的新闻在[Root.GetName]如野火般扩散开来。人们为此十分着迷，媒体充满了对其文化和组织形式的报告和推测。“我们在星系并不孤单”这一真相引起了[Root.Capital.GetName]人民的欢呼。

这些外星人帝国似乎非常古老，他们的科技水平远在我们之上，一定可以教给我们许多知识。
descriptions.en:
The news that we have encountered intelligent alien life for the first time is spreading like wildfire throughout the [Root.GetName]. Our citizens are fascinated by these beings, and the media is full of reports and speculation on their culture and society. The revelation that we are not alone in this galaxy has largely been greeted with celebration on [Root.Capital.GetName].

The empire these aliens have founded appears to be very old, and their level of technology is far ahead of our own. There is no doubt a great deal they could teach us.

descriptions.zh:
我们与智慧外星生命的初次相遇的新闻在整个帝国产生了动乱。这些奇怪生物的录像泄露到了[Root.GetName]的媒体并迅速传播开来，许多人陷入了巨大的恐慌。[Root.Capital.GetName]数个城市发生了不安定事件。

那些奇怪的外星人已发展出远高于我们的科技，似乎在几千年前就实现了空间旅行——可能还要更久。幸运的是，他们似乎是一个衰老与停滞的种群。
descriptions.en:
The news that we have encountered intelligent alien life for the first time has shaken our society to the core. Leaked footage of these bizarre creatures is spreading through media outlets across the [Root.GetName], and many citizens have been gripped by panic. Rioting has been reported in several cities on [Root.Capital.GetName].

The strange xenos have achieved a level of technology far beyond our own, and they appear to have been spacefaring for thousands of years - possibly even longer. Fortunately for us, their kind appear to be a decrepit and stagnating species.

descriptions.zh:
我们的理论模型早就指出星系中有其他智慧文明存在。现在这一理论已被证实。

我们遭遇的这个外星政治实体似乎很古老，拥有远超我们的科技水平。需小心对待。
descriptions.en:
Our theoretical models have long suggested the existence of other intelligent civilizations in our galaxy. This theory has now been confirmed.

The alien political entity that we have encountered appears to be an old one, possessing technology that is far advanced of our own. Caution is advised.

descriptions.zh: 从寂静的太空中，我们的呼唤得到了回应！但第一印象不太对劲，这些人和我们想法不同，他们更喜欢保守自己的秘密。我们目前最好保持距离。
descriptions.en: From out of the silence of space, our calls have been answered! But the initial vibes are totally off; these people don't share our ways, and prefer to keep to themselves. We'd best back off for now.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { has_origin = origin_storm_chasers }

label.zh: 他们的智慧一定非常伟大。
他们的时代已经结束。[Root.Species.GetName]的时代即将来临。
label.en: Their age is over. The time of the [Root.Species.GetName] has come.
They should get with the times.

options.script:
name = progress.6.h.storm
trigger = { has_origin = origin_storm_chasers }

descriptions.zh: 我们已经知道自己在宇宙中并非孤身一人。然而，我们却再次同另一个太空文明相遇了，这一事实让我们忧心忡忡。
descriptions.en: We already knew we were not alone in the universe. Yet, we found our second contact with another space-faring civilization unsettling.

descriptions.zh: 和我们一样，这些外星人显然也是差不过刚刚步入宇宙的大舞台，他们的科技水平也同我们相近。
descriptions.en: Just like us, the aliens appear to be relative newcomers on the galactic stage, and their level of technology is similar to our own.

descriptions.zh: 我们的科技发展水平远远超过了这些外星人。他们尚未具备星际航行的能力。
descriptions.en: Our technological development is far beyond that of these aliens. They have yet to become space-faring.

descriptions.zh: 这些外星人所创立的文明显然十分悠久，他们的科技水平将我们远远地甩在了身后。
descriptions.en: The civilization these aliens have built appears to be very old, and their level of technology is far beyond our own.

descriptions.zh: 我们知道，自己一定会再次找到曾经的主人。我们只是没有预料到会这么快就找到他们。
descriptions.en: We knew we were bound to find our former master again. We just weren't expecting to find them again so soon.

descriptions.zh: 他们的意图要比曾经作为我们主人的那些家伙要好太多了。或许我们只是在第一次同外星人遭遇的时候运气不太好。毕竟，宇宙这么大，总该有些好心肠。
descriptions.en: Their intentions seem far more benign than those of our former masters. Perhaps we were just unfortunate with our first alien encounter. After all, there must be some good in the galaxy.

descriptions.zh: 尽管他们与我们的前主人不尽相同，但却一样地令人可憎。我们开除怀疑是不是星系中其他所有的文明全部都是一肚子坏水。至于想交朋友，我们还不如自己待着。
descriptions.en: They are so different from our former masters, and yet so alike in their reproachable behavior. It makes us wonder if perhaps all other civilizations in the galaxy are riddled with ill will and poor intentions. In terms of friendship, we may just be alone.

descriptions.zh: 他们与我们如此不同，却又如此和蔼可亲。我们好奇这或许就是宇宙中还存在着好外星人的征兆，在繁星之间终究还是存在着一些善良的心的。
descriptions.en: They are so different from us. Yet they are so amicable. We wonder if perhaps this is a sign that there can indeed be good xenos out there. There may be kindness among the stars after all.

descriptions.zh: 他们可真不是宇宙中的什么好东西。我们以前没这么想真是太傻了！
descriptions.en: There truly are no good xenos in the cosmos. It was foolish of us to think otherwise!

descriptions.zh: 我们到底能不能逃离他们的魔爪？
descriptions.en: Will we ever be free from their grasp?
